# Documentation

MaaFramework Go binding `1.3.0` at `80db80c2ef4c253cd098b7a4ce06ed722d8f11a2`.

- **MaaFramework Golang Binding**: This is the Go binding for MaaFramework, providing Go developers with a simple and effective way to use MaaFramework's features within their Go applications. [`README.md`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/maa-framework-go/blob/80db80c2ef4c253cd098b7a4ce06ed722d8f11a2/README.md)
- **MaaFramework Golang 绑定**: 这是 MaaFramework 的Go语言绑定，为Go开发者提供了一种简单而有效的方式，在他们的Go应用程序中使用MaaFramework的功能。 [`README_zh.md`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/maa-framework-go/blob/80db80c2ef4c253cd098b7a4ce06ed722d8f11a2/README_zh.md)
